items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: because my uncle, my uncle George Wilson, buddy, we call him buddy, was telling me about somebody close in the family

ctx.x: And I see, being a small community, there was a lot of things going on, you know. Let me see, because my uncle, my uncle George Wilson, buddy, we call him buddy, was telling me about somebody close in the family wasn't married to somebody. Let's see, some kind of way, my grandmother, one of her brothers and sisters had another father, something like that. So, it was this been like that. Yeah.
Yeah, did, you talk about music in the neighborhood, and people visiting. Did people in those days sit down on their porches and play music?
